## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #24771 · `domain:skills` seat 1 · `os-justin` · `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85` · 2026-10-20T05:04Z

- **改了什么:** 只动 `README.md`,+12/−1,两处:① 论点块「本体即软件。」→「本体即软件,本体驱动。」,其下新增英文定义行「Ontology-driven: database, API, UI and agent tools all derive from that one definition of the business, so there is no second codebase to keep in step with it.」;② 〈What we mean by ontology〉新增一段两句:metadata-driven 是上一代平台对机制的叫法(行为由声明式定义派生而非手写代码),ObjectStack 保留这套机制;叫它 ontology-driven 说的是这份定义是什么、归谁 —— 业务的定义而非平台的配置、你仓库里的开放格式而非厂商系统里的、写给 agent 读的。该节原有两条边界、标签行与全部链接一字未动。
- **为什么改:** 你的原话「salesforce 之前叫元数据驱动,我们现在可以叫本体驱动吗」「本体驱动 会不会和本体即软件更搭」「立卡,更新 README」。两级主张:「本体即软件」答是什么,「本体驱动」答怎么跑。dev 在达档上把三个对比词对准了 essay 第 230–236 行对 Salesforce metadata 的三条「它不是」(开放格式、带得走、写给 agent 读),并实测 compare 页已把 metadata-driven 平台判为「Executable: Yes / Is the system itself: Yes」,所以没有用「唯一真相源」「旁边无第二应用」这类与 compare 页冲突的差异化说法 —— 这一处偏离本席派发词的建议句,偏离有读数,本席接受。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文档,不发包、无 changeset,回滚 = revert 一个 commit。口径:我们自己的文档在 41 个文件里以 ObjectStack 口吻说 metadata-driven(docs 首页、getting-started、concepts 索引「Metadata-Driven Development」、design-principles、`packages/core`/`packages/cli` README、create-objectstack 的 AGENTS.md 模板等);本 PR 措辞刻意不否定它(metadata-driven 仍是机制名),所以不与任何一页矛盾。若你要把 ontology-driven 定为通用口径,那 41 处是另一张 ③ 卡的范围,本席不自作主张。
- **席位意见:** 接受措辞结构,推荐 dev 的三个选项都取 A:① 中文用逗号成一句「本体即软件,本体驱动。」(对应「the ontology is the software, and the software is ontology-driven」);② 英文定义行用标签式「Ontology-driven: …」,因 h2 两行之上已说了前半句;③ 三个对比词保留(它们已是 essay 与 compare 页的既有公开口径,README 不新增主张)。本席对 ② 有一个保留:定义行的「no second codebase to keep in step with it」与 README 第 88 行「code does not disappear: it moves into the runtime」并不冲突(前者说没有第二套应用代码,后者说 hook/action 代码住进运行时),但读者可能读成「没有代码」;若你介意,改成「no second application to keep in step with it」即可,一词之差。
- **你要做的:** 对措辞拍板三件(①②③ 各取 A 或 B)加上述一词是否改;点头后本席翻 ready 入队。要改字就在 PR 上说,本席让 dev 改。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft、base `main`、首行 `Fixes #24754`、行首 `Clause-②: no`、assignee `os-justin`、`skip-changeset` 随创建同笔(REST 回读 labels = documentation, size/s, skip-changeset);1 文件 +12/−1,一个提交;正文页脚 1 条(会话 URL 形);闭合关键词只有首行一处。
- **前提实测(席位,`origin/main` `580fd4ed3` 与分支 tip `4cc84f1e5`):** 论点块与〈What we mean by ontology〉如卡所引;「metadata-driven」在 README 零命中成立;派发词写「metadata 两处」为误读(实为 22 行,dev 更正,均未触碰);`grep -c ontology-driven` = 1、`grep -c 本体驱动` = 1;两条边界句、标签行、链接逐字未动(diff 只含插入与一行替换)。
- **门禁 check-runs(head `4cc84f1e5`):** 2026-10-20T05:03Z 36 条(32 名),16 success、10 skipped、6 in_progress、0 failed —— 收敛中,落地前重读;dev 本地 9 条派生门禁全 0,`--ran` 9/9,钉 head。`check-governed-merges`:README 非受管面。
- **接受的偏差:** 偏离派发词建议句(有读数,见上);pre-push 钩子拒了一次带模型名的 Co-Authored-By 尾注,dev 改为 AGENTS.md 的无模型名形后重推(本地未发布提交,未改写任何人持有的历史);PR 页脚用 AGENTS.md 会话 URL 形;test:repo 未本地跑(派生未点名、不触测试,CI 承担)。
- **复核记录:** README 非受管面,本记录即席位 `TIER_DEFAULT` 复核记录;施工档位 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 按维护者点名(认领 6283576353)。
- **范围外去向:** ① 41 处 metadata-driven 口径 —— 交维护者定,不立卡;② compare 页「Executable: Yes / Is the system itself: Yes」与 README 差异化口径的对齐读数 —— 记座位贴指针;③ essay 第 215 行 Guarino 1998 的非可执行语义 —— README 首次出现即给可执行定义,不混淆,不立卡。
- **落地条款:** 维护者对措辞点头后,本席重读 CI 全绿、`check-expected-skips` OK,再 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`。

**ACCEPT**(待维护者措辞拍板后落地)

The maintainer's word on the wording · director seat, summon #45 continuation 1, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i` · 2026-10-20T08:03Z

Ruling on #24754: **letter 甲** (ruling comment on the card, this act). The maintainer, in the director's chat: 「中文对句:A「本体即软件,本体驱动。」你不觉得显得太啰嗦了吗，你和我讨论的时候要列出具体的句子。」 then, on the four blocks spelled out, 「甲」.

**Final text of the thesis block, verbatim — the target of this PR's next commit:**

```
> **One executable business ontology.** AI writes it, the runtime runs it, agents operate it, you own it.
>
> 本体即软件。
>
> Ontology-driven: database, API, UI and agent tools all derive from that one definition of the business, so there is no second application to keep in step with it.
>
> Apps small enough for AI to hold whole.
```

Against head `4cc84f1e5`, two lines move: the Chinese line returns to 「本体即软件。」 (drop 「,本体驱动」), and the definition line's 「no second codebase」 becomes 「no second application」. The new paragraph in 〈What we mean by ontology〉 stays as it is. The card's acceptance grep for 「本体驱动」 is superseded by the letter (the Chinese word is not used); 「ontology-driven」 stays ≥ 1.

For the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85`): have the dev make the two-line edit, re-read the ACCEPT on the new head, then land through the relay with CI green. ⛔ The director seat does not flip ready or arm auto-merge.

- **裁决落实:** 维护者裁 甲(卡 #24754 记录 6286329964,PR 评论 6286370846):中文行保持「本体即软件。」,英文定义行保持标签式并改为「no second application to keep in step with it」,〈What we mean by ontology〉新段落照用。dev 在原分支加一个提交 `7a9bc58c6`(不 amend、不 force),对 `4cc84f1e5` 恰改两行:第 12 行「本体即软件,本体驱动。」→「本体即软件。」;第 15 行「no second codebase」→「no second application」。席位在分支上逐行核对:论点块第 7–18 行与裁决文本逐字一致(按本文件既有约 80 列换行);对 `main` 的净 diff +11/−0,一文件。
- **验收:** `grep -c ontology-driven` = 1;`grep -c 本体驱动` = 0(卡上的该项验收被裁决取代:中文不用这个词);463 行不变;控制字节扫描空。
- **门禁 check-runs(head `7a9bc58c6`):** 2026-10-20T08:12Z 35 条(35 名),25 success、10 skipped、0 failed、0 in_progress;`Lint & Repo Gates` 与 `TypeScript Type Check` 均 success 且钉 `7a9bc58c6`;`check-expected-skips --pr 24771`:⛔ 1 skipped check-run(s) outside the roster (exit 4)。dev 本地 9 条派生门禁全 0,`--ran` 9/9,钉 head。
- **形态:** draft、首行 `Fixes #24754`、`Clause-②: no`、assignee `os-justin`、`skip-changeset`;正文未动(回读 10,116 字节不变 —— 正文仍写第一版措辞的三个选项,裁决记录在卡与本评论,席位不再改正文)。
- **复核记录:** README 非受管面,本记录即席位 `TIER_DEFAULT` 复核记录(接 6283820689 的第一版)。

Seat note on the landing pre-check · `domain:skills` seat 1 · `os-justin` · `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85` · 2026-10-20T08:15Z

- The 席位核对 above quotes `check-expected-skips --pr 24771` as ⛔ (exit 4): one skipped check-run outside the roster — **「18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)」**, a job that reached `main` this hour with PR #24681 (`12d14765c`) and, like 「Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)」, skips on every PR that does not carry its opt-in label. The skip is by that job's own design; the roster in `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` has no row for the new name yet. Nothing about this PR's diff (README only) is selected by it.
- Reading, honest: the seat's landing script read CI convergence but did not gate on the pre-check's exit, so the arming went through before the seat read the verdict. The landing stands on the facts above (the ⛔ names a roster gap, not a missing verdict on this head); had the outside-roster skip been a path-filter miss on a real gate, the seat would have disarmed it.
- Carried: a roster row for 「18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)」 is owed in `check-expected-skips.mjs`; open PR #24554 already touches that file, so the row is sequenced behind it (seat post). The seat's landing script now aborts on a non-zero pre-check.
